name: class-profile
description: Profile a whole folder of English texts against CEFR levels in one run — the 'class set, not one text' tool. Answers 'which of these texts suits my class?' instead of 'is this one text right?': batch input (directory or glob), a spreadsheet-ready summary (--format csv, one row per text: typical & reached vocabulary band, grammar range, % above target), rank & filter by level (--max-level B1 = 'which of these suits B1?'), fits across several class levels side by side (--targets A2,B1,B2), a pooled CEFR distribution, vocabulary lists exported by CEFR band to CSV (--export-vocab), and per-text pre-teaching handouts / fill-the-gap worksheets / RubricMaker flashcard decks (--export md|csv|flashcards). Mirrors RubricMaker's Vocabulary Profile dashboard. Requires Python 3; the grammar side needs spaCy (degrades gracefully without it).
